name: hcapp_processThirdPartyLogin
description: Handles OAuth login (Facebook, Apple, Google). Resolves an existing Hasher by thirdPartyUserId, email, or thirdPartyEmail — updating OAuth tokens when found. Creates a new Hasher if no match. Syncs Kennel Facebook tokens when loginType = 'facebook'. Returns a write SP success envelope (rowset 0) plus the resolved hasher profile on success (rowset 1), or standard HC6 error detail on failure (rowset 1).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Used to resolve userId and DeviceSecret for compound token validation.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token validated against DeviceSecret + UPPER(userId) compound.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version string. Recorded in HC.ErrorLog on error.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: First name from OAuth provider. Applied via COALESCE on update (preserves existing value if NULL).

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Last name from OAuth provider. Applied via COALESCE on update.

parameters.name: hashName
parameters.description: Hash name. Empty string normalised to NULL before use. Applied via COALESCE on update (preserves existing value if NULL/empty).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Primary email from OAuth provider. Used in hasher resolution lookup and update.

parameters.name: photo
parameters.description: Profile photo URL. Empty string normalised to NULL. On update: COALESCE(existing, @photo, generated bundle avatar) — photo is NOT overwritten if already set.

parameters.name: thirdPartyLoginType
parameters.description: OAuth provider identifier. Expected values: 'facebook', 'apple', 'google'. Drives Facebook-specific update paths.

parameters.name: thirdPartyUserId
parameters.description: OAuth provider's user identifier. Primary key for hasher resolution.

parameters.name: thirdPartyAccessToken
parameters.description: OAuth access token stored against the hasher. Also stored in Hasher.FacebookAccessToken when loginType='facebook'.

parameters.name: thirdPartyAccessTokenExpires
parameters.description: Token expiry. Defaults to '2100-01-01' via COALESCE when NULL. HC6 uses native DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — no longer a brittle NVARCHAR cast.

parameters.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL at entry (means do not update). On the insert path, NULL defaults to 0. On the update path, this parameter is NOT applied — the existing value is always preserved regardless.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Device latitude. Default 0. Used only for USA miles detection on insert. Not stored on update path.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(18,15) vs Hasher.HomeLatitude DECIMAL(12,9). Parameter has higher precision than the column.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Device longitude. Default 0. Used only for USA miles detection on insert. Not stored on update path.
parameters.typeMismatch: DECIMAL(19,15) vs Hasher.HomeLongitude DECIMAL(13,9). Parameter has higher precision than the column.

parameters.name: thirdPartyEmail
parameters.description: Email as reported directly by the OAuth provider (may differ from @email). Used as a secondary resolution key.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success envelope. Always present as rowset 0. success=1 on success (NULL errorCode/errorType). success=0 on any error path.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. Error-specific code on failure (1305=device not found, 1105=bad token, 1905=user not created or db error).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 11=auth, 13=hasher not found, 19=user creation failure or unhandled db error.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on any error path (device not found, invalid token, user not created, CATCH). Standard HC6 error detail shape.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification. 11=invalid token, 13=hasher not found, 19=user creation failure or unhandled error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. 1305=device not registered, 1105=invalid access token, 1905=user not created or db error.

rowsets.name: HasherProfile
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on success. Full profile of the resolved (or newly created) hasher.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Hasher.updatedAt. HC6 returns native DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — no longer cast to NVARCHAR.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher — updates OAuth token fields, name, photo, and Removed=0 when an existing hasher is resolved by thirdPartyUserId/email/thirdPartyEmail
INSERT HC.Hasher — creates a new hasher record when no existing match is found
UPDATE HC.Kennel SET KennelFacebookToken — when thirdPartyLoginType='facebook', syncs the access token to any kennel whose KennelFacebookTokenUsername matches @email or @thirdPartyEmail
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on device not found, invalid token, user not created, or unhandled CATCH error

codeSmells.issue: Post-commit safety check runs outside the transaction
codeSmells.detail: The verification SELECT (lines 214-235) that confirms the hasher was created/found runs after COMMIT TRANSACTION. If the connection drops between COMMIT and the SELECT, the error path fires falsely. The verification query also uses slightly different matching logic than the upsert (drops the thirdPartyEmail=@email cross-check), so a hasher created via that path would not be found by the verification query.

codeSmells.issue: @includeInGlobalHashDirectory sentinel -1 has no effect on the update path
codeSmells.detail: The SP header documents -1 as 'do not update', and the normalisation at line 77 converts -1 to NULL. However on the update path (line 145-165) IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory is never touched — so the sentinel is irrelevant for existing hashers regardless. On the insert path, NULL correctly defaults to 0 via COALESCE. This is not a bug but the parameter semantics are misleading for callers updating an existing hasher.

@latitude is DECIMAL(18,15) but Hasher.HomeLatitude is DECIMAL(12,9). @longitude is DECIMAL(19,15) but Hasher.HomeLongitude is DECIMAL(13,9). The higher-precision parameters will be silently truncated on insert. Does not affect the USA detection logic (which uses the parameter values directly), but any inserted lat/long values will lose precision.

codeSmells.issue: Facebook kennel token sync duplicates trigger behaviour
codeSmells.detail: The explicit UPDATE HC.Kennel at lines 200-207 (inside the transaction) syncs the Facebook token when loginType='facebook'. The HC.Hasher table also has a trigger (trgUpdateKennelToken) that performs the same sync on UPDATE of ThirdPartyAccessToken or ThirdPartyEmail. Both paths will fire for the update case, resulting in two UPDATE HC.Kennel statements per login on the update path. Harmless but redundant.

codeSmells.issue: Hasher resolution uses TOP 1 without ORDER BY
codeSmells.detail: If multiple hashers match the five-way OR condition (thirdPartyUserId, email, thirdPartyEmail cross-matches), TOP 1 returns an arbitrary row. The five-way OR on lines 136-141 is broad enough that a collision between two hashers sharing only an email would pick an unpredictable one.

breakingChanges: @deviceId type changed from NVARCHAR(50) to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER — callers passing string UUIDs must now use typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER binding
@firstName/@lastName/@hashName/@email widened from NVARCHAR(120) to NVARCHAR(250) — non-breaking for callers but fixes silent truncation of values between 121-250 chars
@photo narrowed from NVARCHAR(2000) to NVARCHAR(1000) to match Hasher.Photo — values over 1000 chars will now be rejected by SQL Server parameter binding rather than silently truncated at insert
@thirdPartyEmail widened from NVARCHAR(120) to NVARCHAR(250) to match Hasher.ThirdPartyEmail — non-breaking for callers
@thirdPartyAccessTokenExpires type changed from NVARCHAR(150) to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — callers must pass a typed datetime value, not a date string
@hashersUpdatedAfter parameter removed — this dead parameter was accepted but never used in HC5; callers must remove it from their call signatures
HasherProfile rowset column updatedAt type changed from NVARCHAR(50) (local-time string) to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — callers must parse a typed datetime value instead of a formatted string

Auth error format changed from non-standard Pascal-cased single rowset (HC5 rowset 0: ErrorType/ErrorTitle/ErrorDescription) to standard HC6 two-rowset format (rowset 0: success envelope + rowset 1: error detail)
Hardcoded FILTH Leiden HasherKennelMap insert for new users removed — new users are no longer auto-followed to any kennel on registration
Success envelope (rowset 0: success/errorCode/errorType) added as a new leading rowset — callers expecting HasherProfile as rowset 0 must shift to rowset 1
